items.text: The legal field is long and competitive, so interviews test reasoning and staying power.
Pick the one that matches your story.

Fees and clients become yours with a strong niche.
What earns trust Results, references and clear explanations.

blocks.heading: Growth and AI Behind a Law Answer
Practice Rounds Before the Interview
rows: A stranger can repeat your story back accurately after one hearing.
Say it aloud under a minute.
You finish in about a minute and it sounds like you, not a script.
Your answer to the question you fear holds up without notes.
You keep the same facts when a follow-up changes the angle. Field check: steady on branch choice.
